# Open questions — evidence-intake-project

## Open

### Who is the element re-assessment trail for?

`open` · `@evidence-intake-project.review.reassessment-trail-audience/1`

Changing an element assessment should leave a review trail rather than being refused, as it is today. Unresolved: is that trail user-facing — part of the defender's working record, shown in the element matrix and readable as 'I read this differently in March' — or an admin-facing audit log kept for accountability and not routinely surfaced? The answer decides whether re-assessment reuses `review_events` and `ReviewTarget` (user-facing, same vocabulary as every other decision, needing a new target kind and a trigger-enforced state check on element_links) or gets a separate append-only table with a different read path and different export rules. Element mappings are attorney analysis, so a user-facing trail is also privileged material and must stay out of any discovery export, which an admin-facing log might not need to be.
